extracted.intended_audience: Members of the Agency Task Force on Reports Reduction; CIA Plans Directorate leadership and division managers
extracted.subtask_description: An internal CIA interim progress report summarizing projected savings, changes to project management and reporting required under OMB Circular A-44 submissions, and organizational/management adjustments intended to reduce reporting burden and costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned savings goal ($150,000)
rubrics_metrics.description: Plans Directorate expects to reach its assigned goal of $150,000 in savings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report reaffirms and supplements the oral progress report; projected savings are evaluated across three surfaced areas (country base programming, project management/approval changes, and reductions in component required reporting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Country base programming integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Country base programming is a reality throughout all geographic divisions; documentation has been compiled in time to become an integral part of their Program Submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The projected costs of implementing this management tool, originally factored at a cost (noted in the memo), are accepted as valid and 'expended' — i.e., implementation costs should be recognized against projected savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Savings from project management and approval system changes
rubrics_metrics.description: The greatest area of savings was anticipated to accrue from changes in the project management and approval system; validity rests upon computations based on the provided statistical table of projects and approval levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the statistical table (projects processed by fiscal year and approval level) and treat the cost of project actions as the sum of inventory items 15, 39 and 40. The memo suggests decreases in Directorate-level review imply about one-half of item 15 and roughly 25% of items 39 and 40 will be 'saved'; Divisions' savings are reckoned at about one-third of their costs in items 39 and 40. Apply that formula to estimate net savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce component required reporting (FE Division)
rubrics_metrics.description: FE Division proposed to reduce component required reporting by about $80,000 but reported only marginal progress at this juncture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some specific reductions (e.g., reduced Vietnam ROIC reporting) are cited as contributing to savings. Progress should be tracked against the $80,000 target and broken down by reporting component.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project processing and approval level tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor number of projects processed and their levels of approval across fiscal years (table: FY1970–1973 counts and approval levels are provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The table (e.g., FY1970: 1,242 processed, 606 at DD/P and higher; FY1971: 813 processed, 634 Division; etc.) is the basis for judging where review-level reductions occur and how they affect costs. Use these counts to allocate savings across Directorate vs Division review reductions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net savings computation method ((b + c) - a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Net savings are computed by subtracting 'a' from the sum of 'b' and 'c' to arrive at a result approximating or slightly in excess of the assigned mark.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 'a', 'b', and 'c' refer to the three areas (country base programming, project management/approval changes, and FE Division reporting reductions). Apply the specified subtraction formula to aggregate area-specific savings into a net figure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance flexibility and meaningful employment for Professional Trainees (RID)
rubrics_metrics.description: Significant changes in management of Professional Trainees in RID have been promulgated to enhance flexibility in assignments and afford participants greater opportunity for meaningful employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational/management adjustments should prioritize assignment flexibility and greater opportunity for meaningful work when evaluating personnel-management changes tied to reporting reductions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eliminate repetitious historical documentation in project outlines
rubrics_metrics.description: The DD/P has approved a change designed to eliminate repetitious historical documentation in project outlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Removing redundant historical documentation in project outlines is intended to reduce paperwork and streamline the revised project system; track implementation of this change as part of efficiency gains.
